# Paged Attention

Paged attention manages the [[kv-cache]] in fixed-size blocks, similar to how
an operating system pages virtual memory, which lets a serving system share
and evict cache blocks across concurrent requests.^[raw/articles/kv-cache-explained.md]

## Related

- [[kv-cache]] — the memory structure paged attention manages in blocks.
- [[flash-attention]] — a fused kernel commonly combined with paged attention.
